concepts.summary: Z runs Dribble to the trips side with a Shallow Cross at 5 under a Basic at 12 to 14 and a Dagger behind them at 18 to 20. X is isolated on the backside with a Comeback at 18 (outside release, fade vs cloud) or a Go. The back is a Check Burst.
concepts.progression: 1 Shallow Cross, 2 Basic, 3 Dagger, 4 Check Burst (H)
concepts.qb: 7 step. X Comeback is the alert in the CB cell; X Go is Yes/No in the Go cell.

positions.X: Comeback at 18 yds, outside release, fade vs cloud (CB cell); Go, Yes/No (Go cell)
positions.Z: Dribble: Dagger at 18 to 20 yds, widen to 20 in the second cell
positions.H: Check Burst, fourth in the order

concepts.summary: A High Cross at 18 to 22 between the numbers and the hash is the first look, with a Dagger at 20 (widen at 15) behind a Dagger Pivot at 8 that serves as the outlet. X gets a tag on the backside: Stutter, Stem Go at 10, Swirl T.O. at 10, or Blazer. H checks wide. Rib or Lick sets the back's release.
concepts.progression: 1 High Cross, 2 X tag (alert), 3 Dagger, outlet Dagger Pivot
concepts.qb: 7 step. X tag is the alert; Dagger Pivot is the outlet.

positions.X: Stutter (alert), Stem Go at 10 yds, Swirl T.O. at 10 yds, or Blazer, per the call
positions.Z: High Cross at 18 to 22 yds between the numbers and the hash
positions.Y: Dagger at 20 yds, 15 yd widen point
positions.H: Check Wide; Slam on the way out

concepts.summary: X runs Safe, a Field Post at 18, as the first look. The back's Rib Flat at 3 to 5 is second. Blast at 20 (breaks at 10 and 15) or Blink at 20 by the tagged man is third, with a Swirl at 10 and 15 and a Check Wide as outlets. Read It means the Blast is read on the move.
concepts.progression: 1 Field Post, 2 Rib Flat, 3 Blast or Blink; Swirl and Check Wide are outlets
concepts.qb: 7 step. Read It: play the Blast off the coverage.

positions.tagged: Blast at 20 yds with marks at 10 and 15 (Z or F), or Blink at 20 yds (F)
positions.H: Rib Flat at 3 to 5 yds; Slam first

alerts: Alert printed on the first cell, target unclear

concepts.summary: Boat is a Sail at 12 (Sail T.O. in the first cell) over the back's Rib or Lick Flat at 3 to 5, with a Blazer widening to 15 as the alert and a Cover 2 note next to the Sail. The backside tag is Dagger (widen, 20) or Basic (12, with T.O.). Yacht is the same shape with the Slam and Blazer swapped around the formation. H checks coin at 2 to 4.
concepts.progression: 1 Sail, 2 Rib Flat; Blazer is the alert; backside Dagger or Basic comes off the look
concepts.qb: 7 step. Cover 2 note on the Sail. Widen Blazer is the alert.

positions.F: Boat or Yacht: Sail at 12 yds (Sail T.O. in cell one); X runs it in the Stack cell
positions.X: Dagger at 18 to 20 yds, widen (Z in the Stack cell); Basic T.O. at 12 yds in the Troff cell
positions.H: Rib Flat or Lick Flat at 3 to 5 yds (Lick Flat at 2 to 3); Check Coin at 2 to 4 yds

concepts.summary: F motions and runs Boat (Sail at 12) with Y on a Dunny at 5 beneath it instead of the back flat. Blazer widening to 15 is the alert. X runs Dagger or Basic on the backside and H checks coin at 2 to 4.
concepts.progression: 1 Sail, 2 Dunny, 3 Dagger or Basic; Blazer is the alert
concepts.qb: 7 step. Cover 2 note on the Sail.

positions.X: Dagger at 18 to 20 yds, widen (first cell); Basic at 12 to 14 yds (second cell)
positions.H: Check Coin, outlet at 2 to 4 yds

concepts.summary: Spear is a Dagger at 18 to 20 that pushes and widens, with a Dagger Pivot at 8 under it. The tagged Blink man runs a 20-yd Blink as the Yes/No. H checks wide as the outlet after a Slam.
concepts.progression: 1 Spear (Dagger), 2 Dagger Pivot; Blink is Yes/No; Check Wide is the outlet
concepts.qb: 7 step. Decide the Blink Yes/No off the look, then work Dagger to Pivot.

positions.tagged spear: Dagger at 18 to 20 yds, push and widen (Z or X)
positions.tagged blink: Blink at 20 yds, Yes/No (X or F)
positions.pivot: Dagger Pivot at 8 yds; H or F depending on the cell, unclear

alerts: Alert printed next to the Slam man

concepts.summary: 2x2 with the tagged man on a pushing Dagger at 18 to 20 and a Pylon at 15 on the other side. The outside man runs a Comeback at 18 with an outside release (fade vs cloud) as an alert. Coins puts the back on a Rib Coin at 5 with a Check Coin outlet at 2 to 4. Dapper is the same picture with the Dagger widening to 20.
concepts.progression: 1 Dagger, 2 Comeback alert, 3 Pylon; Rib Coin and Check Coin are outlets
concepts.qb: 7 step. Comeback is the alert, fade vs cloud.

positions.tagged: Sword or Dapper: Dagger at 18 to 20 yds, push (X); Dapper widens to 20 (F)
positions.Z: Comeback at 18 yds, outside release, fade vs cloud, alert
positions.H: Rib Coin at 5 yds; Check Coin outlet at 2 to 4 yds

alerts: Comeback alert, outside release, fade vs cloud

concepts.summary: F runs Bingo, a Blazer, as the first read with a Basic at 12 to 14 behind it. The tagged outside man runs a Comeback at 18 with an outside release (Yes/No, fade vs cloud) on a max split. The back runs Rib Coin at 5 and checks coin at 2 to 4. Shake and Bench are the other tags listed for the outside man.
concepts.progression: 1 Blazer, 2 Basic, 3 Check Coin; Comeback is Yes/No
concepts.qb: 7 step. Comeback is the Yes/No alert.

positions.tagged: Comeback at 18 yds, outside release, fade vs cloud, Yes/No (X or Z); Shake or Bench by tag
positions.Y: Basic at 12 to 14 yds; Slam first in the 3x1 cell
positions.H: Rib Coin at 5 yds; Check Coin at 2 to 4 yds

alerts: Comeback is Yes/No, fade vs cloud

concepts.summary: Three versions of one 3x1 picture. The first read is a Search at 15 that settles in the open grass between the hashes. The back's Rib Flat at 3 to 5 is second. The third man changes by word: Warrant is a Swirl at 10 and 15, Badge is a Blink at 20, Blast is the 20-yd Blast with marks at 10 and 15. X can add a Short Post (7 steps, Yes/No). H slams and checks wide.
concepts.progression: 1 Search, 2 Rib Flat, 3 Swirl, Blink or Blast
concepts.qb: 7 step. Short Post tag on X is Yes/No.

positions.Y: Search at 15 yds, find the void between the hashes
positions.Z: Warrant: Swirl at 10 and 15 yds; Badge: Blink at 20 yds; Blast: Blast at 20 yds with 10 and 15 marks
positions.X: unlabeled in the base cells; Short Post in 7 steps, Yes/No, when tagged
positions.H: Rib Flat at 3 to 5 yds; Check Wide

concepts.summary: Pearls is a Pylon at 15 as the first read, a Swirl at 10 and 15 as the second, and the back's Rib Flat at 3 to 5 as the third, with a Cover 2 note on the Pylon. X runs Dagger at 18 to 20 or Basic at 12 to 14 on the backside, Basic T.O. in the third cell. H checks coin at 2 to 4.
concepts.progression: 1 Pylon, 2 Swirl, 3 Rib Flat, 4 Basic (second cell); Check Coin outlet
concepts.qb: 7 step. Cover 2 note on the Pylon. Basic T.O. is the alert in the third cell.

positions.X: Dagger at 18 to 20 yds (cell one); Basic at 12 to 14 yds (cell two); Basic T.O., alert (cell three)
positions.H: Rib Flat at 3 to 5 yds; Check Coin at 2 to 4 yds

concepts.summary: Mirrored 2x2 deep concept. Bench puts both outside men on a Bench at 18 to 20 with C.O. routes at 5 inside, the back on a Check Option outlet at 5. Obama keeps the Bench but adds the Bang Flat at 3 to 5 and a Slam. Bench T.O. turns the tagged outside man loose.
concepts.progression: 1 Bench, 2 C.O. (Bench, each side); 1 Bench, 2 Bang Flat (Obama)
concepts.qb: 7 step. Pick a side; Check Option is the outlet.

positions.X: Bench at 18 to 20 yds, 15 yd mark; Bench T.O. when tagged
positions.Y: C.O. at 5 yds (Bench); Slam then release (Obama)
positions.F: C.O. at 5 yds (Bench); Slam then release (Obama)
positions.H: Check Option, outlet at 5 yds (Bench); Bang Flat at 3 to 5 yds (Obama)

concepts.summary: Mirrored Swirls at 10 and 15 from both inside men with the back's Bang Flat at 3 to 5 under them and a Slam outside. Bozo changes one side to a Basic at 12 to 14 and makes the other Swirl a Swirl T.O. Check Option at 5 is the outlet.
concepts.progression: 1 Swirl, 2 Bang Flat (Swirl); 1 Swirl T.O., 2 Slam, 3 Basic (Bozo), order unclear
concepts.qb: 7 step. Check Option is the outlet.

positions.Y: Swirl at 10 and 15 yds; Basic at 12 to 14 yds in Bozo
positions.F: Swirl at 10 and 15 yds; Swirl T.O. in Bozo
positions.H: Bang Flat at 3 to 5 yds; Check Option outlet at 5 yds

concepts.summary: Three crossing-route cousins off Scrabble protection from the same Swift formation. Samurai: Far Cross at 22 to 25 over a Low Cross at 10 to 12, Rib Shallow at 5, Lick Flat at 3 to 5, Dagger widening to 20. Sensei: Sail at 12 and 15 with a Deep Diagonal, Lick Shallow at 5, Rib Flat at 3 to 5. Shredder: Blazer, Deep Diagonal and Deep Skinny over the Rib Shallow and Lick Flat.
concepts.progression: Samurai 1 to 5 with Far Cross and Low Cross early, order unclear; Sensei 1 to 5; Shredder 1 and 2 with an outlet
concepts.qb: 7 step. Sensei and Shredder carry alerts on the deep routes.

positions.samurai: Far Cross 22 to 25 yds, Low Cross 10 to 12 yds, Rib Shallow 5 yds, Lick Flat 3 to 5 yds, Dagger widen 20 yds
positions.sensei: Sail 12 and 15 yds (alert), Deep Diagonal, Lick Shallow 5 yds, Rib Flat 3 to 5 yds
positions.shredder: Blazer, Deep Diagonal, Deep Skinny (alert), Rib Shallow 5 yds, Lick Flat 3 to 5 yds, outlet
positions.letters: which letter runs which route is unclear from the text

alerts: Shredder: alerts on the deep routes
